releases.0.1.4-beta.1:
Build your own overlays in Tools → Overlay Studio, with texts, shapes, pictures, videos, gifts and viewers on one canvas.
Elements and groups get 12 entrances and exits, and can move on each event or all the time.
Show your camera on stream with Overlay Studio's Camera element, cut to a circle if you like.
The Games overlay shows the seconds left on a timed Turn into mob step.
When your LIVE's connection drops and stays down, Tokio says it's reconnecting every 30 seconds until it's back.
Coin stats counts a LIVE's last gifts as soon as it ends.
releases.0.1.5-beta.1:
Home has a new layout. Activity runs down the right side, with the song that's playing at the bottom.
During a LIVE, Home charts your viewers minute by minute and shows your top 3 gifters.
Turn the overlay server on and off with the new Overlays switch in Active features.
Your sounds, images and videos moved from Settings to Alerts → Library, where you can search them.
Import your own overlays with the + button on the Overlays page, and search the official ones by name or description.
In Settings → Logs, you can export all of Tokio's logs as one .zip to send when you report a bug.
Take the tour from About to see each page and how to connect. On a new install, it opens the first time Tokio starts.
While an update downloads, a ring in the title bar fills up. During a LIVE, Restart to update stays gray.
When you skip a song in the YouTube window or in Spotify, the next request starts within a minute.
